items.headline: RBI keeps repo rate unchanged, hints at future tightening if inflation persists
items.summary: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) maintained its policy repo rate at 5.25% following the August 2026 MPC meeting. However, policymakers signaled potential policy rate tightening in Q3 FY27 if elevated food and fuel prices, driven by the Middle East conflict and rupee pressure, lead to a broader increase in inflation. CPI inflation for July 2026 rose to 4.45%, with the RBI projecting FY27 CPI inflation at 5.0% (Q3 at 5.9%). The Indian government remains focused on capital expenditure and GST 2.0 reforms.

items.headline: Global markets dip as crude oil surges past $100 amid Middle East conflict
items.summary: Global markets exerted negative pressure on Indian equities, with Asian markets and Wall Street (Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq) largely lower. Brent crude futures surged to nearly $102 per barrel due to escalating conflict in the Middle East. The US 10-year Treasury yield also moved higher to 4.857%, contributing to negative sentiment, while GIFT Nifty signaled a negative to muted start for Indian equities.

items.headline: Gaja Alternative Asset Management, Shankesh Jewellers to announce Q1 FY27 results
items.summary: Gaja Alternative Asset Management and Shankesh Jewellers are scheduled to announce their Q1 FY27 (June 2026 quarter) results on September 10, 2026.

items.headline: Graphite India reports strong Q1 FY27 earnings with 28% profit rise
items.summary: Graphite India reported robust Q1 FY27 results, with consolidated net profit climbing 28% to ₹171 crore and revenue growing 26.6% to ₹842 crore. The strong performance was attributed to margin expansion and healthy growth in its Graphite and Carbon, and Steel segments.

items.headline: Midcap index down, Smallcap up; Power and Metal sectors see buying
items.summary: In early trade, the BSE Midcap Select Index saw a decline, while the BSE Smallcap Select Index gained. The power and metal sectors experienced buying interest, whereas the metal and auto sectors faced selling pressure. Nifty IT was a top drag, falling over 3%.

items.headline: Rising crude prices pose mixed impact on oil, paint, and tyre companies
items.summary: Higher crude prices could positively impact oil-linked upstream companies such as ONGC and Oil India. Conversely, Oil Marketing Companies (OMCs) like Indian Oil, BPCL, and HPCL may face margin pressure if they cannot pass on increased costs. Paint and tyre companies, which use crude derivatives as key raw materials, are also likely to experience margin pressure.

items.headline: ICICI Prudential AMC gets RBI nod to acquire up to 9.95% stake in four banks
items.summary: ICICI Prudential Asset Management Company received approval from the RBI to acquire an aggregate stake of up to 9.95% in the paid-up share capital or voting rights of CSB Bank, DCB Bank, Kotak Mahindra Bank, and AU Small Finance Bank.

items.headline: Dilip Buildcon secures ₹1,800 crore LPG pipeline project from PNGRB
items.summary: Dilip Buildcon secured a Letter of Intent (LOI) valued at ₹1,800 crore from the Petroleum and Natural Gas Regulatory Board (PNGRB) for a project to lay, build, operate, or expand an LPG pipeline from Paradip, Odisha, to Raipur, Chhattisgarh.

items.headline: Hindustan Zinc partners MFL India for electric truck transportation
items.summary: Hindustan Zinc entered a six-year transportation agreement with MFL India for the deployment of 30 electric trucks, enhancing its logistics sustainability.

items.headline: Focus Lighting bags ₹10-17 crore order from Larsen & Toubro
items.summary: Focus Lighting and Fixtures secured an order worth ₹10-17 crore from Larsen & Toubro for the supply of street lighting poles.

items.headline: Enviro Infra Engineers subsidiary secures ₹224 crore wind EPC project
items.summary: Suyog Urja, a subsidiary of Enviro Infra Engineers, secured a Letter of Intent (LOI) valued at ₹224.19 crore for a 180 MW wind EPC project from Tata Power Renewable Energy.

items.headline: Equitas Small Finance Bank board to consider raising funds via bonds
items.summary: Equitas Small Finance Bank's board is scheduled to meet on September 16, 2026, to consider raising funds through a private placement of Lower Tier II bonds.
